flags.message: The combined brief-in-opposition.txt is marked truncated and ends mid-sentence on printed page 17 of the detainees' brief, after Washington's argument and a lengthy appendix. The detainees' later preemption and vehicle arguments are not available in the staged text. The forecast uses the available opposition, complete SG brief and reply, and does not infer acquiescence from the omitted pages. Consider preserving each opposition's argument before appending lengthy appendices.
